newsitem.title: USA: RenaissanceRe plans to buy 813,190 shrs.
newsitem.headline: RenaissanceRe plans to buy 813,190 shrs.

text.p: RenaissanceRe Holdings Ltd said on Thursday a preliminary count indicated about 1.9 million of its common shares were tendered for purchase and cancellation by the company, but it planned to accept 813,190 shares for purchase.
RenaissanceRe began its tender offer on December 23. The offer expired at midnight EST on January 22, it said.
The company said it would accept 813,190 shares for purchase and cancellation. All shares tendered by odd lot holders would be accepted for purchase, it said.

As a result of the oversubscription, the number of shares to be purchased from each tendering shareholder, other than odd lot holders, would be subject to a proration factor of an estimated 41.5 percent, it said.
Following the offer, the company would have about 22.8 million common shares outstanding, it said.
